xlsx.before: Pick 1 or more rune gems and install them on a Common-Epic item; each gem is a new line or replaces an existing line (destroyed, no gem back). One line per attribute family (item_generation_steps 7): a gem of a family the item already has replaces that line. Bonus passive slots still apply: at most 1 bonus passive (2H: 2); a passive gem needs a free slot or replaces the existing bonus passive. New rarity = the highest of (a) the current rarity (rarity never goes down), (b) the minimum rarity of the rarest line (T1 and T2 = Uncommon, T3 = Rare, T4 = Epic; a passive = its minimum rarity), (c) the budget check: bonus points the item already has never count against it. The check raises the rarity only when the new total is above BOTH the current rarity's normal budget (Uncommon 100 / Rare 150 / Epic 200; 2H doubled) AND the item's own total before this forge; then the new rarity is the lowest one whose budget holds the new total. An Epic over 200 can be forged as long as its total does not rise above its own total (RESOLVED (USER) 2026-11-01). Example: Common sword + STR T2 (100) = Uncommon; + VIT T2 (total 200) = Epic. A single T4 gem makes any item Epic, 1H or 2H. The result must fit the Runeforge capacity rarity and BP (row 54). Fortune gems are allowed (row 58). Raising rarity charges the crystal steps (row 43), the forge fee and the levelling catch-up (rows 48, 55). After every forge the item is renamed (row 58).
